text:
alice: heads-up: after we enabled sticky-routing-canary in eu-central, we see a short reconnect storm. console socket_count drops for ~2m but streaming.events are nearly flat. sampling?

ben: which canary and when?

alice: sticky-routing v3 rolled at 09:02:12 -> spike at 09:04. logs show many 101->close with sampled=false. pasted sample: `09:04:03 conn=x1 route=eu-central tenant=partnerA upgrade=101 close=client.reset sampled=false`

sana: yep sampling 1/500 for high-churn streams. canary traffic is tiny so it gets filtered out. that blinds dashboards during rollouts.

ops-bot: deploy 1817001200 applied to service/router-canary at 09:02:12

alice: two quick asks: (1) force-sample canary-tagged requests for 10m, (2) emit a low-cardinality probe metric on upgrade/close paths marked telemetry_only.

ben: agreed. also add conditional `rollout_id` tag only when header `x-rollout-id` present. do not leak tenant ids.

console-team: on dashboard side we'll add `sum(stream.probe)` and a sample_fraction indicator; show rollout_id only when toggle enabled to avoid noise.

sana: implementation sketch: `if req.headers['x-rollout-candidate']=='1': metrics.sampling=1.0; metrics.emit('stream.probe',{telemetry_only:'true', rollout_id:req.headers['x-rollout-id']||'canary-1817001200'})`

ben: and CB tweak: relax queue_delay threshold to 2x for canaries to avoid transient trips during sticky migration.

alice: runbook snippet: if reconnect_rate > 120/min and probe_count < 30 in 5m => rollback canary. else scale sampling for 15m and re-evaluate.

ops-bot: incident INC-2401 created: "sticky-routing canary reconnections - missing streaming telemetry" assigned to @alice priority=P2

alice: i'll open PRs for proxy sampling override + probe emit and a rollout banner in console. will post links. leaving thread for async updates. thanks.
